subject: Compliance add-ons billing split: implementation amortization vs pass-through
messages:
From: Agnieszka Kowalski <agnieszka.k@careline.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@careline.com
Date: 2026-08-29T16:12:00Z
Subject: Compliance add-ons billing split question

Rafael —

Thanks for the demo last week. We ran the internal cost review for the compliance/security add-ons (audit logs retention tiering, KMS/HSM seat licensing, and a HIPAA-specific residency package) and finance is asking whether these are invoiced as one-time implementation fees (onboarding + HSM setup) or as recurring licenses/operational fees.

Specifically: can you send two example invoice schedules — (A) implementation fee amortized over 12 months and (B) pass-through (full upfront with monthly license) — with the net cash impact for our 12-month pilot (expected usage: 20k embeddings/month, 4 concurrent LLM sessions)? Also: any flexibility on offsetting initial onboarding with credits if we commit to 12 months?

Attached: Careline_RFP_2026.pdf (requirements + compliance checklist).

Best,
Agnieszka
Agnieszka Kowalski
Director, Procurement — Careline Health
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Agnieszka Kowalski <agnieszka.k@careline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons billing split question

Agnieszka —

Thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. I can put together the two invoice schedules this afternoon. Quick clarifying points so the examples match your finance assumptions:

- For HSM/KMS: do you expect dedicated HSM seats (single-tenant) or would you accept shared-KMS with customer-managed keys?
- Audit log retention: which tier are you targeting (30/90/365 days)? Pricing differs materially at 365.

We do offer two common approaches that align with what you described:
1) Implementation amortized: one-time setup fee invoiced, amortized over 12 months for internal accounting (we can show either as a single invoice plus monthly credit or as monthly invoice spread).
2) Pass-through upfront: full setup charged on first invoice and lower recurring fees thereafter.

As a negotiation path we can provide an onboarding credit for a 12-month committed term — typically 10% of the implementation charge or a fixed $Xk credit depending on structure. Looping in Marissa (pricing) and Ben (account) to propose concrete numbers and any additional concessions.

Attachment: SOC2-summary.xlsx (high level evidence we referenced on the call).

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T13:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons billing split question (pricing options)

Folks —

Putting concrete numbers against Rafael's templates (assume pilot term = 12 months). These are illustrative and we can tweak based on final usage numbers, but should be safe to present to Careline finance: 

Option A — Amortized implementation (preferred for customers with fixed-term accounting)
- Implementation/onboarding: $45,000 one-time, amortized over 12 months = $3,750/month (we can show as monthly invoice line)
- KMS/HSM: $2,500/month per dedicated HSM seat OR $1,200/month for shared KMS (customer-managed keys)
- Audit logs: Tier 2 (90 days) included in base; Tier 3 (365 days) +$1,800/month
- Residency (HIPAA region): $3,000/month (data residency & additional audit tooling)
- Onboarding credit: 10% of implementation ($4,500) applied upfront if customer signs 12-month commit

Net first-month cash (after credit): Implementation invoice net = $40,500 + prorated monthly fees. Monthly run rate (post month-1): approx $7k - $11k depending on KMS choice and retention tier.

Option B — Pass-through upfront
- Implementation invoiced full $45,000 on month 1
- Lower monthly fees: KMS/HSM reduced by 10% on recurring when pass-through chosen (volume incentive)
- We can offer 3 months complimentary of Tier 2 audit retention for pass-through customers as an onboarding concession

Commercial concessions we can approve (with Rafael sign-off):
- Trade: 12-month commit required for credits above
- Additional 5% discount on recurring fees if customer commits to a 24-month renewal at signing

Notes on packaging: audit/log retention and residency are typically billed as recurring operational fees; HSM seats are either capex-like (one-time setup + monthly maintenance) or fully recurring depending on whether we provision dedicated hardware. Present both models side-by-side to Careline finance.

Attaching a short SOW skeleton (SOW-draft.pdf) so procurement can see invoice timing.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Pricing & Packaging
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Agnieszka Kowalski <agnieszka.k@careline.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons billing split question

Agnieszka / team —

We can move forward with Option A (12-month amortization) as Marissa outlined. Practical tweaks to accelerate sign:
- We'll reduce the dedicated HSM seat list price by 10% for the pilot (effective monthly reduction $250/seat).
- Add three months of complimentary Tier 2 audit retention (90 days) to the pilot onboarding package.
- Onboarding credit remains 10% of the implementation charge; we'll apply it on invoice 1.

Please confirm you have internal approval for a 12-month committed pilot. If yes, Rafael and I will finalize the SOW and an invoice schedule (we'll show the amortized monthly lines so your accounting team can map easily).

Deal ID: CL-2026-0891
Target signature date: 2026-09-15

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (outline of deliverables & invoice timing)
From: Agnieszka Kowalski <agnieszka.k@careline.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T14:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons billing split question

Rafael / Ben / Marissa —

Thanks — this is helpful and closely aligned to our internal ask. We confirm internal approval for a 12-month committed pilot under the amortized implementation model. The concessions you outlined (10% onboarding credit + 10% HSM reduction + 3 months complimentary Tier 2 audit logs) look acceptable.

Next steps on our side: we'll raise a PO for the committed pilot following receipt of the SOW and the invoice schedule. Please send the final SOW and the amortized invoice schedule (month-by-month) so procurement can route for PO creation.

Best,
Agnieszka
Agnieszka Kowalski
Director, Procurement — Careline Health
Attachment: PROCUREMENT-PO-REQ.docx (placeholder; procurement will attach PO after SOW)
